author: Evan A.
review: Perfect chicharrón, great pastor flavor, and huge rice and beans portions.

author: Bobby S.
review: The #17 birria de res combo and carne asada tacos were both fresh and good.

author: Simon K.
review: Great post-golf meal! Fresh, flavorful shrimp ceviche and grilled chicken.

author: M (Local Reviewer)
review: Demolished the chicken milanesa torta! Tangy salsa, homey vibes, sweet owners.

author: Teresa E.
review: Amazing food amounts for the price. We had plenty of lunch leftovers!

author: Kayls
review: Reasonable prices, fast preparation, and great food. A new favorite!

author: Keith
review: Love this place. Finally found amazing Mexican food after moving from Seattle.

author: Casandra Q.
review: Delicious and well-priced, but the mild salsa was still a bit spicy for kids.

author: Estella
review: Huge servings! Incredible pan dulce from the bakery. I want the honey chipotle chicken next.

author: Tammy S.
review: First time trying this spot. Everything from the butcher counter came out super hot and fresh.

author: Bethany
review: Our favorite weeknight takeout spot. Quick, consistent, and great tacos.

author: Kelcey
review: Amazing food! The house marinade on the carne asada is perfectly savory.

author: David L.
review: Clean, comfy dining room next to the market. Large portions. Highly recommend combos.

author: Marcus T.
review: Best lunch spot. The fresh salsa bar is the finest in Auburn. Fast too.

author: Sarah M.
review: A delightful, authentic gem. Cozy market and restaurant run by a charming couple.

author: Chris P.
review: Food arrived steaming hot. Generous portions and excellent seasoned beef flavor from the butcher.

author: Jessica H.
review: The chicken pozole and spicy menudo are absolutely great for the rain.

author: Jason B.
review: Large portions worth every cent. They do not skimp on their meat cuts.

author: Amanda R.
review: Homey ambience and friendly owners who treat you just like family.

author: Ryan K.
review: The daily lunch specials offer incredible value for a quick casual meal.
